summary: Cline added the Ox Alpha stealth model to its Free options: full coding-agent access at no cost with rate limits, alongside benchmark claims of marginal improvement over Fable and GPT. Announced by the official Cline account on August 21, 2026.
claim_steps: Install the CLI: npm i -g cline
Select Ox Alpha under Free options.

social_proof.author: Cline
social_proof.text: Ox Alpha (stealth model) is now free in Cline. Early benchmarks shows marginal improvement over Fable and GPT. Try it with: npm i -g cline and use /models to see it under Free options
